grid: 1 km × 1 km cells, 30 × 30 km pilot windows

rules.observation: positive = >=1 VIIRS S-NPP (FIRMS SP archive to 2026-06-30, NRT after) detection with confidence nominal/high in the cell on the UTC date; valid_negative_candidate = no detection AND per-cell evidence of a usable clear observation (requires VIIRS fire-mask product; none ingested -> 0 rows); insufficient_observation = no detection, FIRMS data present for the date, observation quality unknown; missing_observation = FIRMS request failed or date outside product availability (FIRMS data_availability API). Cloudiness from weather is NOT used.
rules.weather: POWER_AVAILABILITY_LAG_DAYS = 3 (conservative; exact historical publication dates are not published per record). For prediction date D, weather and soil-moisture features use observation_date = D - lag; rolling windows end at D - lag. Physical values unchanged.
rules.landCover: Esri/Impact Observatory annual 10 m map matched to each year 2020–2025; 2026 dates use the 2025 map (flagged prior_year_proxy).
rules.admin2: geoBoundaries ADM2 (DRC: OCHA territories/cities; Algeria: UNHCR/GAUL communes), maximum-area overlap per 1 km cell; cells outside every unit (sea) stay empty.
